## 中文原文
今天是休息日，我原本打算早上出门去爬山。我提前准备好了背包、水和一些小零食，闹钟定在了七点。起床后发现外面下起大雨，爬山计划只能取消。我转而在家整理房间，中途翻出几本很久没看的旧书，不知不觉看了很久，度过了安静的一天

## My translation
Today is a off-work day, I was planning to climb a mountain in the morning.
I had my backpack, water and some snacks ready, and the alarm clock was set at 7 am.
When I got up, it was pouring outside, so I had to cancle the original climbing plan.
Then I stayed at home, and came across several old books that I hadn't been reading for a long time.
So I started to read, and before I knew it, a quiet day has passed.

## Revised version
Today was an off-work day, and I planned to go mountain climbing in the morning.
I packed water and some snacks in my backpack, and set the alarm for 7 am.
When I woke up, it was pouring outside, so I had to cancel the original climbing plan.
I stayed home instead and found some old books that I hadn't read in a long time.
I started reading them, and before I knew it, a quiet day had passed.

## Key phrases
- mountain climbing
- pack sth. in backpack
- set alarm for 7 am
- in a long time, not for
